name: zebra-language
description: Language support for Zebra (.zbr): live diagnostics via the built-in `zebra lsp` language server, plus syntax highlighting.

zebra.serverPath.description: Path to the zebra executable (which provides the `zebra lsp` server). Use an absolute path to a local build, e.g. C:/Projects/zebra-language/zig-out/bin/zebra.exe, or put zig-out/bin on your PATH.

zebra.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the Zebra language server (Output panel → 'Zebra Language Server').
